about.title: About Lingrove at CMRTC
about.subtitle: Empowering Rural Communities through Bamboo Innovation
about.p1: Lingrove is an initiative rooted in the village of Lingala, supported by CMRTC (CMR Technical Campus) to bridge ancient bamboo processing heritage with modern digital commerce.
about.p2: We provide hands-on machinery training, safety certification, and an open marketplace where rural craftspeople directly market their creations to consumers nationwide, eliminating intermediaries.
about.mission_1_desc: Structured machinery, splitting, and weaving tutorials for sustainable livelihoods.
about.mission_2_desc: Transparent pricing directly benefiting Lingala village craftspeople.
about.mission_3_desc: Replacing single-use plastics with 100% natural biodegradable bamboo.
about.mission_4_desc: Empowering women and youth as independent business leaders.

how_it_works.title: How Lingrove Works
how_it_works.subtitle: A complete empowerment journey from raw culm to digital commerce
how_it_works.step1_desc: Master cutting, splitting, slicing, and weaving techniques through step-by-step videos and machine manuals.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Craft high-quality utilitarian and decorative bamboo products using verified CMRTC safety techniques.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Upload product listings with photos, set fair prices with our cost calculator, and receive orders directly.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Track recorded sales earnings, earn certified craftsmanship badges, and expand rural livelihood.
